description: Lightweight steering agent which does some prepopulation and then handles agent handoff.

beforeAgentCallbacks.description: Sets the flag "enable_fallback_and_reclassification" to enable reclassification only for lightweight steering agent.

afterAgentCallbacks.description: [10-step Limit Handling] Reset LLM steps to 0 at the end of the turn.

beforeModelCallbacks.description: [10-step Limit Handling] Count the LLM steps and prevent the conversation from failing due to reaching 10-step limit by returning a fallback response at 10th step.

Deterministic greeting:
1. Call get_call_context and fetch_init_json
2. Call store_lookup
3. Play no barge in greeting and legal disclaimer, and run ANI lookup in parallel
4. Play membership, spanish/extension, emergency message, and proactive message.

Handle DFCX agent transfer (for non-computing-troubleshooting intents, spanish, agent request menu), Computer Troubleshooting Agent transfer, or Twilio queue transfer (for extension). Also hides transfer_to_agent to prevent native transfers and always force tool calls.
